The '''Island Trader''' is a bluebird merchant located on the North side of [[Ginger Island#Island North|Ginger Island]]. Like the [[Desert Trader]], the Island Trader does not accept gold but only barters in exchange for other items.

The Island Trader is unlocked for {{Price|10|Walnut}} [[Golden Walnut]]s after purchasing the [[Island Farmhouse]].
